uma_settlement_accounting: SELECT r.oo_request_id,r.currency asset,6 asset_decimals,r.economic_status,r.effective_bond_raw,r.final_fee_raw,r.principal_returned_raw,r.explicit_report_reward_raw,r.dispute_winner_reward_raw,r.reward_refunded_or_rolled_raw,r.protocol_fee_raw,r.gross_payout_raw,f.settlement_transfer_raw,f.settlement_flow_exact,r.payout_qc_gap_raw,r.source_tx request_tx,r.settlement_tx,r.oo_request_id nonadditive_group FROM read_parquet('overleaf_revision_20261026_guide2/temporal_data/data/curated/parquet/polygon_uma_request_rounds.parquet') r LEFT JOIN read_parquet('overleaf_revision_20261026_guide2/temporal_data/data/curated/parquet/polygon_uma_request_flow_qc.parquet') f USING(oo_request_id)
tellor_dispute_reconciliation: SELECT dispute_id,vote_result,reporter,disputer,asset,asset_decimals,slash_amount_raw initiation_escrow_raw,CASE WHEN vote_result IN ('SUPPORT','NO_QUORUM_MAJORITY_SUPPORT') THEN slash_amount_raw ELSE '0' END applied_loss_under_recorded_outcome_rule_raw,CASE WHEN vote_result LIKE '%SUPPORT' THEN 'report_rejected' ELSE 'report_supported' END protocol_report_outcome,NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ application_time_utc,source_tx,source_block,'historical_rule_binding_qualified' evidence_status FROM read_parquet('overleaf_revision_20261026_guide2/temporal_data/data/curated/parquet/tellor_disputes.parquet')
dvm_net_stake_applications: SELECT actor voter,raw_data_words[1] recorded_net_adjustment_raw,raw_data_words[2] post_stake_raw,CASE WHEN try_cast(raw_data_words[1] AS HUGEINT)>=0 OR try_cast(raw_data_words[2] AS HUGEINT)>0 THEN raw_data_words[1] END supported_net_stake_delta_raw,CASE WHEN try_cast(raw_data_words[1] AS HUGEINT)<0 AND try_cast(raw_data_words[2] AS HUGEINT)=0 THEN 'pre_state_required_for_clipping' ELSE 'net_application_state_rule' END evidence_status,event_time_utc,source_tx,source_block,log_index,'net_application_not_additive_with_request_accrual' stage_rule FROM read_parquet('overleaf_revision_20261026_guide2/temporal_data/data/curated/parquet/uma_dvm_staking_events.parquet') WHERE event='VoterSlashApplied'
